soap_data.subjective: Patient reports mild seasonal allergy symptoms including sneezing and congestion.
soap_data.objective: Clear nasal discharge, no wheezing, clear breath sounds, normal temperature.
soap_data.plan: Prescribed Cetirizine 10mg once daily as needed. Recommended avoidance of known environmental allergens.
